values.short: ~15 s total: 2 content stills + end beat, VO 26-34 words incl. 'Still unsolved.' One object, one impossible thing.
values.long: house shape ~30-38 s: 5 content stills + end beat, VO 70-95 words

why: Avg watch is ~8 s of ~35 s (retention ~0.22). Our model says the floor is set by format not case; a film people finish and rewatch may get expanded. Cheapest format change we have.
read: plays at first snap >=14h (dead film = 0, noted); secondary avg watch s and 72h plays. Page-level daily views checked over the posting days before reading.
call: usual rule: one value leads by >=1.5x median at n>=5 each -> default; n>=8 each with no lead -> tie. Batch 1 = 2+2 (below); continue coin-flipped pairs until n=5 each.
harm_check: if short films run <0.67x long at n>=5, short is dropped (it can lose, and we'd see it).
note: all four fresh, in-shape (old object / empty place, no named victim). Both shorts drew hook=detail by the coin; hook is read across all films, not inside this batch.
